content: If you suspect a medical emergency, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center without delay. In the United States, you can reach the poison control center at 1-800-222-1222. Do not dispose of medications by flushing them down the toilet or pouring them into a drain unless specifically instructed to do so. The information provided here was last updated in May 2024.
